2024_162_aug_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for August 2024 itemizes every district p-card charge and credit for the cycle, each line carrying a merchant description, the journal-entry label AUG 2024 PCARD EXP, a budget unit, an account code, and an amount. The 31-page listing, printed 10/10/2024 and presented to the Board of Education on October 15, 2024, ends with a subtotal of 360,619.31 in charges against 5,757.09 in credits, for Total Expenses of 354,862.22. The single largest charge is 13,725.48 to N AMERICA RE on 8/19/2024, coded to budget unit 101668266244000, account 5990.
